title: FailurePlanterOutput
description: Structured output of the Failure Planter agent: the corrupted C function plus the ground truth for every failure it planted. The planted-failure items are exactly PlantedFailure — the same shape stored on Run.plantedFailures.

code.description: Complete C source for the corrupted function, same signature as the correct version it was derived from.

declineReason.description: Empty when failures were planted. Otherwise why the requested failure mode could not be planted in this computation; plantedFailures is then empty.
